department: Doctoral Programme in Electrical Engineering (ELEC), School of Electrical Engineering

deadline.value: Continuous admission with cut-offs about every month (nothing is processed in July); the 2026 cut-offs include 3 Nov and 1 Dec 2026. Salaried positions are advertised and applied for separately.
deadline.quote: The Doctoral Programme in Electrical Engineering invites applications continuously (applications will not be processed in July). | Tue 3 November 2026 | Tue 1 December 2026

gre_subject.value: Not stated on the page checked

supervisor.value: You need a supervising professor who is willing to supervise you before you apply for the study right.
supervisor.quote: You need to have a supervising professor who is willing to supervise your doctoral studies

funding.value: Funding is not automatic: full-time study needs funding secured for at least the first 6 months (a salaried position, project funding or a grant). No tuition fees.
funding.quote: Full-time students are required to have funding allocated for the doctoral studies for at least the first 6 months | Most Aalto doctoral students combine different funding sources during their studies. | Aalto University doctoral studies are free of tuition fees.

entry_route.value: A relevant master's degree (or equivalent from abroad) is needed to be eligible.
entry_route.quote: Relevant master’s degree awarded by a Finnish university or a Finnish university of applied sciences, or a corresponding degree completed abroad

notes: Same Aalto-wide language rules as the university record. Apply for the study right after agreeing with a professor; salaried positions are advertised separately.
